title: Deloitte Workload Balancer
why: Consulting runs on billable hours and tight deadlines, and long weeks can quietly lower output and raise burnout. This tool finds the point where extra hours stop paying off and where work gets stuck.
problem: Management observes declining productivity despite increasing working hours. Build an AI system that analyzes workload, overtime, absenteeism, task completion, employee engagement and performance data to identify potential operational bottlenecks and recommend workload interventions.
data_note: 600 consultants in 24 engagement teams, 26 weeks of timesheets, task logs and pulse surveys (sample data).

steps.detail: Hours, overtime, absence, tasks, deadlines, engagement, ratings
Tasks completed per hour and on-time rate
Quadratic regression of weekly output on hours
Distance-based outlier score on hours, absence and engagement
Average wait at each review stage of the deliverable flow
Correlate overtime with absence and engagement
Cap hours, move excess work to lighter teams

questions: At how many hours does output start falling?
Where does work get stuck in review?
What happens if we cap hours at 50?
author: K Bhargav Raju
